description: Avianca LifeMiles for a flight operated by Avianca. LifeMiles = fare in US dollars (whole ticket, without taxes, fees and extras) x rate by fare family (Basic and Light 3, Classic 6, Flex 8, Business 10), plus an Elite bonus of that base (Red Plus 10%, Silver 20%, Gold 60%, Diamond 80%, Magno 100%), rounded down. Qualifying miles = the base LifeMiles plus 1 per 20 bonus LifeMiles. Progress toward Red Plus (6,000), Silver (12,000), Gold (24,000), Diamond (45,000) and Magno (110,000) qualifying miles in a calendar year; qm is the qualifying miles so far. Uses cwsi.net's calculator and the airline's published rules. Unofficial.

creditClass.description: The booking class letter on the ticket, for creditTo (required with creditTo). Ignored without creditTo.

creditFlights.description: The flights for creditTo: one entry per one-way flight, in order, with its great-circle miles (calculate_flight_distance gives them) and optionally from/to airport codes. Defaults to segs when they carry miles.

from.description: The departure airport's code; labels the breakdown.

miles.description: Great-circle distance of this flight in miles.

to.description: The arrival airport's code; labels the breakdown.

creditStatus.description: Your status in the creditTo program, by its name as listed under creditTo. Defaults to the base level. Ignored without creditTo.

creditTo.description: Credit the flights to a partner program instead of Avianca's own: united = United MileagePlus (creditStatus one of: General member, Premier Silver, Premier Gold, Premier Platinum, Premier 1K); aeroplan = Aeroplan (creditStatus one of: Aeroplan Member, 25K, 35K, 50K, 75K, Super Elite). Earns by each flight's distance and the booking class at the program's published partner rates; leave creditTo out for the airline's own program. Give the booking class letter as creditClass. Give the flights as creditFlights (one entry per flight with its great-circle miles). No price is needed with creditTo.

fare.description: Fare family. BS = Basic (3 per $1, domestic flights); LT = Light (3 per $1, international flights); CL = Classic (6 per $1); FX = Flex (8 per $1); BZ = Business (10 per $1, Business Classic, Business Flex, INSIGNIA). Shown on your booking. Avianca does not publish booking class letters for its fare families.

price.description: Fare paid (USD, whole ticket) in US dollars. In US dollars: the fare for the whole ticket without taxes, fees and additional services (bags, seats and other extras). Required unless creditTo is given.

qm.description: Qualifying miles you have so far this year (optional). Used only for the progress toward the next Elite status.

status.description: Your LifeMiles Elite status when you fly. NO = No Elite status (no bonus); RP = Red Plus (10% bonus); SV = Silver (20% bonus); GD = Gold (60% bonus); DI = Diamond (80% bonus); MG = Magno (100% bonus).
